low_00.note: Published observed blue polyline, not instrument raw data. Amplitude normalized; two Doppler replicas share hyperfine parameters. Central instrument artefacts require masks.
low_00.doppler_convention: full replica-to-replica separation in kHz; shifts are +/- separation/2
low_00.artifact_evidence: Isolated narrow Lille spike, provisionally treated as an instrumental artifact. Overlapping molecular groups remain in the joint model.
